title: Nek's Fabric Mods!
description: A modpack containing Nekky9180's mods for Fabric.
body:
A modpack containing all of [Nekky9180](https://modrinth.com/user/Nekky9180)'s mods that run on fabric.

Here are the mods in the modpack:
[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (required to make other mods work)
[Command Maker SE](https://modrinth.com/mod/command-maker)
[Command Maker CE](https://modrinth.com/mod/command-maker-client) (Not avaliable yet, waiting to be approved by moderators)
[Nek's Silly Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/nek-silly-mod)
[Nek's Silly Mod 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/neks-silly-mod-2)
